name: B10-0339/2026 – Recital D – Am 13
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: D. whereas access constraints, including bureaucratic impediments, restrictions on movement, interference by parties to conflicts, and threats posed by religious extremism in conflict-affected areas, are increasingly limiting the ability of humanitarian actors to reach affected populations; whereas Christians in conflict-affected areas are disproportionately exposed to violence, including targeted killings, attacks on churches and properties, abductions and forced displacement, with thousands killed annually because of their faith; whereas the growing scale of persecution of Christians worldwide remains insufficiently addressed;
